title: Signal Pricing Group Rule
description: Declares how the fees of signals sharing one pricing_group combine when selected in the same package. A group with no rule is charged 'each'. Only the selected cpm options of one currency are compared per thousand impressions; flat_fee, per_unit, custom and percent_of_media options are not comparable and are always charged 'each'. At most one rule per pricing_group. Experimental (x-status: experimental): sellers declaring this MUST list signals.pricing_groups in experimental_features.

pricing_group.description: The pricing_group key this rule applies to.

pricing_combination.description: 'highest': charge only the highest selected cpm fee in the group; the seller applies this and the buyer still sends pricing_option_id for every priced signal it selects. 'each': charge every selected signal's fee.
